<div class="card-body">
'''Hoth: Echo Corridor (Dark)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ホス：エコー基地通路</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここに滞在しているなら、上書きされた自分のホスのロケーションをすべて一番上に持ってくることができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Hoth-Echo-Corridor-Dark-PSA-152940017.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hoth: Echo Base corridor.

'''Dark Side:'''
If you are present here, you may bring all of your converted Hoth locations to the top.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese requires you to be present here; the English if you occupy.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hoth: Echo Corridor (Dark)]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
